description: This file defines the WorkflowReminderRepository class, which provides methods to interact with workflow reminder data in a database, including finding, updating, creating, and retrieving detailed reminder records.

classes.name: WorkflowReminderRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing workflow reminder data, including methods for querying, updating, and creating reminders.

methods.name: findScheduledMessagesToCancel
methods.description: Retrieves scheduled messages that are eligible for cancellation based on team ID and user credits.

methods.name: updateRemindersToEmail
methods.description: Updates specified reminders to use email method and clears reference IDs.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new workflow reminder with provided details.

methods.name: findByIdIncludeStepAndWorkflow
methods.description: Fetches a reminder by ID, including detailed related workflow step and workflow information.
